description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for self-service savings products in the Fineract project. It exposes endpoints to retrieve all savings products or a specific savings product for a client, with security and dependency injection handled via annotations.

classes.name: SelfSavingsProductsApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class providing endpoints for self-service savings products, supporting retrieval of all products or specific product details with client validation.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all savings products associated with a client, validating client mapping before delegating to underlying API.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific savings product by ID for a client, validating client mapping before delegating.
